meta.name: The Burbs
meta.description: Set in present-day suburbia, a young couple returns to the husband's childhood home. Their world is upended when new neighbors move in across the street, bringing old secrets of the cul-de-sac to light, and new deadly threats shatter the illusion of their quiet little neighborhood.

videos.title: The Goddamn Brownies
videos.overview: Samira and Rob's suburban life is upended when a mysterious new neighbor moves into the Victorian.

videos.title: Mind Your Own Business
videos.overview: Samira becomes convinced that her new neighbor is up to no good and possibly involved in a crime.

videos.title: Sardine?
videos.overview: When a neighbor's dog goes missing, Samira and her new friends break into the Victorian to find it.

videos.title: A Nine on the Tension Scale
videos.overview: A neighborhood block party brings secrets to light; Samira suspects that Rob is hiding something.

videos.title: The Old Face-to-Face
videos.overview: As glimpses of Rob and Naveen's past surface, Samira makes a discovery that changes everything.

videos.title: Neighbor Take Warning
videos.overview: The cul-de-sac crew goes on a mission to find answers and save a neighbor who may be in danger.

videos.title: Do Not Mess with Suburbanites
videos.overview: Just when the cul-de-sac crew thinks they’ve run into a dead end, danger arrives on Ashfield Place.

videos.title: Only One Way Out
videos.overview: Samira uncovers a conspiracy that could ruin Hinkley Hills' image as "The Safest Town in America."

meta.slogan: Every cul-de-sac has a dead end.
